_comment: Owner-editable inputs for the narrative-intelligence layer (src/intel.js, docs/NARRATIVE_INTELLIGENCE.md §13.3). pin: stories.json placement keys always sampled. exclude: placement keys never probed (also settings.intel.exclude). stories: stories the cluster pipeline never surfaced, probed like a placed story. queries: saved recent-search queries with REAL X operators only (no from:list pseudo-operator), one recency page each per night. from_sets: from: handle sets used when a List is missing or private (≤28 handles per query).

queries.label: Any district emergency
queries.query: (shelter OR evacuation OR "active shooter" OR "shelter in place") -is:retweet lang:en

queries.label: Flooding
queries.query: (flood OR flooding) (shelter OR OEM OR evacuate OR evacuation OR evacuations) -is:retweet lang:en

queries.label: Wildfire
queries.query: (wildfire OR "brush fire") (evacuate OR evacuation OR evacuations OR contained OR containment) -is:retweet lang:en
